question: Does MTP1 improve APEX over an explicitly head-sharded no-MTP configuration, rather than the weaker default replicated-attention control?
model: Unmodified APEX-I-Compact, same six files for both arms
primary_metric: pooled generation milliseconds per public completion token in each process
statistics: paired log latency ratio with two-sided Student-t 95% confidence interval, df=3
secondary: raw generation milliseconds per whole answer
raw client wall milliseconds per whole answer
qualification_limits: Same model files do not imply identical floating reduction path/token trajectory under different target row shapes. Cold/warm semantic differences remain separately reported; this is not a full quality-equivalence certificate.
stop_rule: Any protocol or abnormal teardown failure stops the run. No replacement points or lowered gates. No further winner search is performed with the confirmation data.
